# LifePower Control v0.3.2

This patch release improves upgrade messaging and several administration UI
details found while reviewing `v0.3.1`.

## Administration UI

- The Overview host image is displayed at a larger size with a restrained
  frame and shadow, and its Remove button now sits beside the image.
- A failed saved-job edit now reports the reason next to the save action and
  moves focus to the error. This includes the intentional refusal to change a
  job that is still referenced by the duty-cycle run list.
- Saved-job lifecycle entries on the Activity page link their subject to the
  Jobs collection. Run entries continue to link to the individual run.
- The documented interface screenshots have been refreshed and expanded.

## Installation and service messages

- Upgrade and downgrade completion messages no longer claim that a one-time
  setup link was printed. Fresh installation and preserved-data
  reinstallation still show the essential first-time setup guidance.
- The production web startup log now identifies the web administration
  service instead of calling it a development shell.

## Compatibility and safety

The supported hardware and operating-system scope, state schema, dependencies,
hardware safeguards, and power-control boundaries are unchanged from
`v0.3.1`. Ordinary tests remain deterministic and hardware-independent.
